candidates.change_summary: Change the ownership check from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner so non-owners can withdraw and the owner is blocked.
Delete the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are allowed.
Change amount > 0 to amount >= 0 so a zero-value transfer no longer reverts.
Replace the transfer amount with the contract's full balance so a different amount is sent than requested.
Remove the requirement that msg.sender is the owner, allowing any caller to send funds.
Remove the requirement that the receiver is not the zero address, allowing transfers to address(0) to succeed.
Remove the requirement that amount is greater than zero, allowing zero-value sends to complete without reverting.
Replace the transfer amount with amount + 1 so one extra wei is sent on every call.
Remove the owner check so any caller can send funds.
Remove the zero-address check so funds can be sent to address(0).
Remove the positive-amount check so zero-value transfers are allowed.
Replace transfer with call so failed transfers no longer revert and gas forwarding changes.
Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) check so non-owners can send funds.
Delete the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to the zero address proceed (and revert differently).
Delete the require(amount > 0) check so zero-value transfers are allowed instead of reverting.
Delete the transfer statement so validated calls complete without moving any Ether.
Replace msg.sender == owner with tx.origin == owner so calls relayed through contracts by the owner are allowed.
Replace transfer(amount) with transfer(amount - 1) so one wei less is sent on every transfer.
Remove the require(msg.sender == owner) check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Remove the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to address zero are attempted.
Remove the require(amount > 0) check so zero-value transfers are allowed.
Replace the low-level transfer with a call so failed transfers no longer revert and excess gas is forwarded.
Move the ownership check to after the transfer so a non-owner call can first execute the transfer before reverting.
